references.text: The regulations for the grain offering and drink offering that were to accompany the various animal sacrifices are given here, and these rules are what is referred to as 'according to the ordinance' in Numbers 29:27.
The amounts of grain offering and drink offering that were to accompany bulls, rams, and lambs are specified here, and this is the standard followed in Numbers 29:27.
The same wording is used for the grain offering and drink offering on the second day of the Feast of Tabernacles, showing the repeated pattern throughout the festival.
Parallel verse for the third day of the Feast of Tabernacles with identical wording regarding the grain offering and drink offering according to the ordinance.
Parallel verse for the fourth day of the Feast of Tabernacles with the same instructions concerning the grain offering and drink offering.

Summary of the Lord's feasts including burnt offerings, grain offerings, peace offerings, and drink offerings, each on its proper day.
